title: DR reflection plan: business layer (replacement pairs)
rationale: Mirrors the business-layer plan reviewed in Gate B (proposal 0b6d60f8): its seq 4 deletes a type whose named replacement is the reverse pair, and its seq 17 (row 17) deletes businessrole performs businessfunction naming a replacement that links a different pair.

operations.rationale: Remove business.businessrole.assigned-to.business.businessinterface: business.businessinterface.serves.business.businessrole already exists and expresses it. Plan kind reverse, p 0.68; claims rel:business.businessrole#3.

evidence.quote: BusinessRole assigned-to BusinessInterface has the wrong direction compared with ArchiMate.

operations.rationale: Remove business.businessrole.performs.business.businessfunction: business.businessrole.assigned-to.business.businessprocess already exists and expresses it. Plan kind compound, p 0.41; claims rel:business.businessrole#1.

evidence.quote: BusinessRole assigned-to BusinessFunction and BusinessRole performs BusinessFunction express the same meaning.
